# Duolingo

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 1 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Gamified learning: lesson flow, streaks, leaderboards, chunky 3D buttons, a mascot-led brand.

Captured 2026-09-25, signed in, free account. Themes: light, dark.

A token set and component reference for Duolingo's web app, for building mockups in Figma or Paper that match the product. It was extracted from www.duolingo.com on 2026-09-25, signed in to a free account on the Japanese course, in both of the app's themes, at desktop width and at a 570px mobile width.

## Colors

The roles below are the catalog's swatches for the `light` theme. The front matter then lists every colour token under `light`, named by its path with dots turned into hyphens.

- **primary (#58cc02):** `light.accent.primary.face`
- **neutral (#ffffff):** `light.background.page`
- **surface (#f7f7f7):** `light.surface.subtle`
- **on-surface (#4b4b4b):** `light.text.primary`
- **on-surface-variant (#777777):** `light.text.secondary`
- **outline (#e5e5e5):** `light.border.default`

## Typography

39 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: duolingo-sans.

### Fonts (from README.md)

The app uses `duolingo-sans` for all UI text (one variable upright file serving 400 and 700, plus an italic) and `feather` 700 as a display face, seen on the logged-out marketing page. Both are proprietary and are not committed. The style guide looks for them in a local `fonts/` folder next to it (gitignored) and falls back to Nunito from Google Fonts, showing a notice when it does. [tokens-notes.md](tokens-notes.md#fonts) says which CDN file is which.

## Components

No component tokens map onto DESIGN.md's component properties.

Measured states, crops and the full inventory: [components.md](components.md), [components](components), [style-guide.html](style-guide.html).

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
